outfit.name: 解构落肩炭灰廓形卫衣与机能皮腿带
outfit.prose: A premium heavyweight washed-charcoal oversized hoodie with an off-center silver zip funnel collar, hitting mid-thigh over tailored black micro shorts. Sheer black 20D over-knee stockings feature a snug elastic band that softly pinches the pale thigh, reinforced with a tactical leather thigh strap sporting a miniature matte-black clip, finished with lug-sole Chelsea boots.
